verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own release notes announce an official Rust SDK, so the capability exists, but it is only in Preview. The pack has no documentation of a broader set of stable client libraries. The bq CLI and the Simba ODBC/JDBC drivers are different tools, not SDKs, and get no credit here. Missing for 10: documented GA official SDKs across mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Java, Go, Node), in-depth SDK reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Rust SDK for BigQuery is now in Preview.
